race.comment: MOTOSCAFO (8) comes here deep into the prep with a good record here. Complete mystery last start with a battling seventh over 1600m at Warwick Farm. Assess on the good third two back at Rosehill. Finds a nice race and can turn things around. SHAMEDY (4) country-trained gelding who surprised at the good odds with a tough second in the Moree Cup over 1400m. Key jockey change and he gets a much better set-up. Each-way. RED RAGS TO BULLS (5) tough mare holding her form and will find this much easier. Held her ground to the line with a respectable fifth over 1500m at Rosehill in BM78 class. Goes well here and the claim helps. Look for her late. IN SOCIETY (10) comes down from Queensland and assess on the good win three back over 1600m at Doomben. Can race closer and sneak into the minor money.
